title: Intro to HTML and CSS
line: Build a page, style it and make it fit a phone.

project.title: A portfolio page of your own
project.brief: Build index.html and styles.css on your own. A header with a nav bar, a row of three project cards, a contact form and a layout that stacks on a phone.
checks: index.html has header, main and footer and links styles.css
A flex container lays out at least three cards
A media query changes the layout below 600 px wide

lessons.title: Your first web page
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner to write index.html in VS Code with a doctype, head, title and body, add a heading and a paragraph to make an about me page, and open it in a browser.
lessons.passes: index.html has a doctype, a title, one h1 and one paragraph.

lessons.title: Headings, paragraphs and lists
lessons.goal: Teach HTML headings, paragraphs, strong and em, and ordered and unordered lists by writing a paper plane guide with a list of materials and numbered folding steps.
lessons.passes: The page has an h1, a ul of materials and an ol of steps.

lessons.title: Links and images
lessons.goal: Teach HTML links and images, with href, src, alt text and relative paths, by building a city guide page with three links and two pictures.
lessons.passes: The page has three links with an href and two images with alt text.

lessons.title: Semantic page layout
lessons.goal: Teach the HTML tags header, nav, main, section and footer by laying out the home page of a cafe with a menu section and opening hours.
lessons.passes: The page uses header, nav, main and footer, each exactly once.

lessons.title: Forms and inputs
lessons.goal: Teach HTML forms, with label, input types, required and button, by building a table booking form that asks for a name, an email and a number of guests.
lessons.passes: The form has three labeled inputs, one of type email, and a submit button.

lessons.title: Your first stylesheet
lessons.goal: Teach linking styles.css to an HTML page and CSS element, class and id selectors by styling the headings, the menu and one special dish on the cafe page.
lessons.passes: The page links styles.css, which has an element, a class and an id rule.

lessons.title: Colors and fonts
lessons.goal: Teach CSS color, background-color, font-family, font-size and line-height by styling a quote card with a dark background and large serif text.
lessons.passes: The card rule sets color, background-color, font-family and font-size.

lessons.title: The box model
lessons.goal: Teach the CSS box model, with width, padding, border, margin and box-sizing, by building a profile card that is exactly 300 px wide.
lessons.passes: The card is 300 px wide with border-box sizing, padding and a border.

lessons.title: Flexbox
lessons.goal: Teach CSS flexbox, with display flex, justify-content, align-items and gap, by building a navigation bar with a logo on the left and links on the right.
lessons.passes: The nav rule uses display flex with justify-content set to space-between.

lessons.title: Make it fit a phone
lessons.goal: Teach responsive CSS with the viewport meta tag and a media query by building a three-column pricing section that stacks into one column on a phone.
lessons.passes: A media query at 600 px or less switches the columns to a single stack.
